correctness.rationale: Every support is reduced to a contact vertex; the regular-simplex Gram inverse yields the exact normal constraint. The volume identity is derived by integrating affine facet heights over their orthogonal projections. For each chamber, Cauchy equalization and a signed fractional-linear derivative force equal coordinates in both groups, reducing the problem to five rational functions. Their exact derivatives and radical maxima are replayed by verify.py. The resulting bound is \(6+2\sqrt{511}/7\), and equality conditions yield exactly 42 supports. The numerical convex-hull check is explicitly nonessential.
